down: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target image 1 is the current two-frame blue/ivory sniper walking animation. Image 2 is only a guide for alternating walking feet. Repaint the two COMPLETE full-body sprites as an exact FRONTAL WALK toward the viewer. Both heads must look directly out toward camera, symmetric face with TWO dark eyes, central nose, no side-facing nose or profile, no three-quarter yaw. Shoulders and chest face forward, hair/headband retained. Keep character costume and proportions recognizable: pure dark navy hair, ivory headband, ivory shoulder/chest plates, blue tunic with ivory side panels, brown diagonal quiver strap and belt, skin upper arms, ivory bracers/shins, navy boots. Both bow and bow-holding hand on IMAGE RIGHT, empty hand on IMAGE LEFT. Back quiver at image-left shoulder. Preserve restrained five material colors navy #172638 blue #3976b5 ivory #e4e1c8 peach #dda77d muted brown #8c6b45, no glossy highlights. Frame LEFT: image-right foot planted low, image-left leg lifted and bent. Frame RIGHT: image-left foot planted low, image-right leg lifted. Two legs unmistakably alternate. Hold the EXACT SAME head, connected neck, shoulders, chest and belt at the same relative position in both sprites. Only arms and legs articulate, bow hand subtly moves vertically. Head must join a visible centered neck and collar without gap. Two figures in one horizontal row with generous transparent separation, same scale and baseline. Clean low-resolution JRPG tactical pixel art, hard square pixels, no smooth edges, no shadows on ground, no labels or guides. Transparent background. Preserve all anatomy and full bow endpoints; do not crop.

Keep EXACT SAME head and torso coordinates and scale in both frames; motion only in limb joints.
